facts.fact: In a Forrester and Acoustic report, 84% of marketers say channel engagement data from emails, mobile phones, or websites is important, but only 68% successfully collect it.
facts.quote: While 84% of marketers recognize the importance of channel engagement data from emails, mobile phones, or websites, only 68% successfully collect this data.

facts.fact: In the same Forrester and Acoustic report, 81% of marketers find web and mobile data important, but only 63% collect it.
facts.quote: 81% find it important, but only 63% collect it

facts.fact: In the same Forrester and Acoustic report, 75% of marketers consider real-time experience data critical, yet only 47% gather it.
facts.quote: 75% consider it critical, yet merely 47% gather it

facts.fact: Dynamic creative optimization (DCO) automatically creates personalized ads based on data about the viewer at the moment of ad serving, using real-time data to change creative elements.
facts.quote: One way to do this is through dynamic creative optimization (DCO), which allows you to automatically create personalized ads based on data about the viewer at the moment of ad serving.
